BLAST_BURN.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
BLAST_BURN.summary: Deals special damage to every enemy standing in the up-to-8 cells around the caster. Not a status or buff ability.

targeting.who: all enemy entities in the cells adjacent to the CASTER (allies are skipped)
targeting.note: the cast still needs the caster to have a target (requiresTarget defaults to true), but the area is centered on the caster, not the target

geometry.shape: 3x3 ring around the caster, center excluded

declaredRaw.note: table [30,60,120,240] indexed by stars-1; 240 is also the fallback; no 4-star unit of this family exists in the pilot

effects.scaling: AP: damage * (1 + ap/100) (apBoost default true); crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT, canCritByDefault=false)
effects.resolution: after AP and crit, handleDamage divides SPECIAL damage by (1 + 0.05 * target speDef) before further, untraced modifiers

BLAST_BURN.positionalConditions: The caster's own cell defines the area; enemies outside the 8 adjacent cells are not hit. No other positional condition.
BLAST_BURN.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept: every cast deals the same declared raw damage to whoever is adjacent at that moment. No modes.
BLAST_BURN.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 30/60/120. Resolved damage (AP, crit, speDef division, other effects) is not a stored number; only the formula pieces above were read.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, effects, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division was read

CRUNCH.scope: TOTODILE in this production reference (the development snapshot declares BITE for TOTODILE). The same strategy is also declared by CROCONAW, FERALIGATR and GUZZLORD; those are outside this pilot.
CRUNCH.summary: Deals special damage to the caster's current target; if that hit kills it, the caster heals for half of the victim's max HP.

effects.scaling: AP: damage * (1 + ap/100) (6th argument apBoost = true); crit multiplier only if the cast crit
effects.resolution: then handleDamage's speDef division and later untraced modifiers

effects.condition: only when handleSpecialDamage reports death for that hit

VESPIQUEN_ORDERS.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
VESPIQUEN_ORDERS.summary: VESPIQUEN_ORDERS itself has no effect beyond the generic cast bookkeeping (spend maxPP, count the cast, play the animation). The unit's real abilities are three mode abilities (ATTACK_ORDER, HEAL_ORDER, DEFEND_ORDER) that a passive writes into the unit's skill when the player moves it to row 1, 2 or 3.

identifierOnlyBehavior.effects: none specific: pp = max(0, pp - maxPP), count.ult += 1, broadcastAbility, record in blue/redAbilitiesCast; OnAbilityCastEffects (items/passives) still run

modeSelection.mechanism: PassiveEffects[Passive.VESPIQUEN] has an OnChangePositionEffect: newY 1 -> range 3 + ATTACK_ORDER; newY 2 -> range 2 + HEAL_ORDER; newY 3 -> range 1 + DEFEND_ORDER; other rows change nothing
modeSelection.appliedTo: the board Pokemon, from onPokemonChangePosition (manual position changes); PokemonEntity copies skill and range at fight start

modes.setBy: PassiveEffects[Passive.VESPIQUEN] when the unit is moved to row 1
does: spawns one COMBEE ally at the nearest free cell (random among ties; none if the board has no free cell)
enrages every allied COMBEE on the board (including the new one) for 3000 ms: +80 speed, protect cleared, healing/shield received halved while enraged

nextAttackBonus.kind: special damage added to the caster's next basic attack, then removed
nextAttackBonus.N: allied COMBEE on the board at the moment of that attack (living entities)
nextAttackBonus.scaling: (base + N*per) * (1 + ap/100), times the ability-crit factor only if ABILITY_CRIT and the attack crit; delivered via handleSpecialDamage(..., crit=false, apBoost=false)

modes.setBy: PassiveEffects[Passive.VESPIQUEN] when the unit is moved to row 2
does: spawns one COMBEE ally (same placement rule)
for the caster and for every allied COMBEE on the board (new one included), heals every allied unit in that healer's 8 adjacent cells and clears its negative statuses

heal.scaling: handleHeal(heal, caster, apBoost 1, crit): * (1 + ap/100), * critPower on crit
heal.stacking: each (healer, adjacent ally) pair heals once, so an ally adjacent to several healers is healed several times; a healer is healed only if adjacent to another healer

modes.setBy: PassiveEffects[Passive.VESPIQUEN] when the unit is moved to row 3
does: spawns one COMBEE ally (same placement rule)
gives every allied COMBEE (new one included) a shield
gives the caster a shield of (1 + N) * shield where N is the number of allied COMBEE counted in that loop

shield.scaling: addShield(value, caster, apBoost 1, crit): * (1 + ap/100), * critPower on crit; enraged recipients halve it; entity wrapper applies a Big Eater Belt buff first

starBehavior.note: Vespiquen is declared 3 stars, so index 2 of each table applies: attack bonus 60 + 30N, heal 30, shield 30. The 4th entries are the fallback values.

VESPIQUEN_ORDERS.positionalConditions: The row where the player places Vespiquen selects the mode (rows 1/2/3 on the player's side); the board-cell geometry of Heal Order depends on where the healers stand. Which row is the 'front' row was not established.
VESPIQUEN_ORDERS.repeatedCastsAndModes: Each cast spawns another Combee if a free cell exists, so Combee count (and thus Attack Order's bonus, Defend Order's caster shield and the number of Heal Order healers) grows with repeated casts. ATTACK_ORDER_NEXT_ATTACK is a set member, so casting again before the next attack does not stack the bonus. Mode is fixed for the fight by the row chosen before it.
VESPIQUEN_ORDERS.rawVsResolved: Declared raw amounts per mode are in the mode records; none is a final resolved number (AP, crit, enrage halving, wound, belts and the generic damage/heal pipeline apply).
